name: com.crosswirepay/crosswire
title: Crosswire - payment infrastructure pricing, coverage and stack design
description: Indicative pricing, coverage and stack design for high-risk and crypto payment infrastructure.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Default first call. Returns routed results across FAQ, solutions, coverage and the pricing entry point.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Returns the full grounded text for an id that search returned.

tools.name: get_indicative_price
tools.description: The only pricing source. Returns a bounded indicative range for a product, volume and market.

tools.name: list_solutions
tools.description: Lists the capabilities and rails Crosswire can put in a stack.

tools.name: check_coverage
tools.description: Answers which regions, countries and markets a capability is available in.

tools.name: recommend_stack
tools.description: Returns the products that fit a described business, with no price.

tools.name: request_offer
tools.description: Records a single-rail enquiry or a target rate for the commercial team. Requires stated consent.

tools.name: create_solution_offer
tools.description: Creates the indicative commercial offer for a designed stack. The offer link is emailed, never returned here.

tools.name: book_advisory
tools.description: Books a call with a person at Crosswire.

tools.name: get_faq
tools.description: Grounding answers and a routing map, for when the right tool is unclear.

tools.name: ask_integration
tools.description: Answers how a rail is integrated, sequenced and operated day to day.

tools.name: assess_business
tools.description: Reads a described business or current setup and returns its needs and gaps.

tools.name: design_stack
tools.description: Returns an architecture: the rails, their dependencies and the order to build them.

tools.name: compare_stack_scenarios
tools.description: Compares two or more described architectures at capability level.

tools.name: submit_partner_application
tools.description: Submits an application to join the Crosswire partner network.
